entities.summary: Cape Sounion is the promontory at the southernmost tip of the Attica peninsula, 8 kilometres (5.0 mi) south of the town of Lavrio, and 69.5 km southeast of Athens in the Athens Riviera. It is part of Lavreotiki municipality, East Attica, Greece.
